document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
To your dismay, your canoe has been chopped to pieces. It 
is beyond repair. You and your students study the vandalism. 
The  only  clues  are  tiny,  hand-like  tracks  on  the  ground 
around the wreckage.
They are fresh. The perpetrators cannot be far.
